name: A Win Pays The Mission On Its Card
note: ChatGPT CH21-01 (2026-10-21, D25): the 15th win of an intermediate player with Lv.4 cleared was judged against the advanced mission it had just unlocked, not the Lv.3 one on the card — no calendar mark, no hint. Each case checks that its day is still a boundary before it counts.

mutations.name: the mission is read after the win again
mutations.why: The original order: the win counted first, the mission read from the moved count. The 14->15 cases lose their mark and hint; 13->14 and the mission's own game do not notice — which is why it shipped.
mutations.replace: const dailyRecords = loadDailyRecords(); const mission = getDailyMission(todayKey);
mutations.expectFailure: the win was judged against the mission its own count unlocked

mutations.name: a mission win records its day as a solved puzzle
mutations.why: D36 (2026-11-06): the calendar would tell a player whose day was finished by its mission that they had solved its puzzle.

mutations.name: the battle mission records its day as a solved puzzle
mutations.why: D36: the 1v1 / AI battle mission writes the day from the result window — the same wrong message as above.
mutations.expectFailure: the battle mission must record its day as via=mission
